description: This source file defines custom assertion methods for testing command-related objects within the Eclipse Ditto project, including Command, CommandResponse, and ErrorResponse assertions.

classes.name: CommandAssertions
classes.description: A utility class providing custom assertion methods for testing command-related objects in the Eclipse Ditto framework.
